articleTitle: Student Writing Segmentation Using Various Classification Techniques
abstract: Writing is a crucial aspect of learning. It encourages you to clarify and sort out concepts and analyse textual evidence, and practice conclusions, which improves understanding and aids the cognitive development. This current study proposes an automated framework model that can assess and offer feedback on a student’s argumentative writing skills by segmenting the texts and classifying them. As a result, it will contribute to giving individuals more opportunities to develop their writing. Most of the 15601 text files (144294 sentences) used in the evaluation were written by students in grades 6 to 12. Deep learning models were developed based on a random collection of 80% of the phrases, and then evaluated on the other 20%, in order to assess the automated analysis of evaluation in writing. To compare the outcomes, we have employed classification machine learning methods like Passive Aggressive Classifier and Random Forest with deep learning techniques including Recurrent Neural Network i.e., RNN and Long short-term memory i.e., LSTM. Using these methods, student’s essays were segregated based on lead, position, claim, counterclaim, rebuttal, and conclusion. The accuracy of our suggested BiLSTM based model is 74.38% and 81.23% ,LSTM-based model is 76.2% and 88.49% based on different hyperparameters, 62.4% for Random Forest-based models and 61.5% accuracy for Passive Aggressive Classifier (PAC). We can infer from the accuracy that LSTM performs better than BiLSTM, RF and PAC in terms of performance. As a result, this study aids in essay segmentation and generates a solution for text segmentation that is fairly accurate.

articleTitle: Dynamic Computing Networks in the Modern Era
abstract: In the modern age, when the need for real-time data exchange and analysis is constantly growing, dynamic networks have emerged as a crucial field of study. These networks are distinguished by their tendency to self-adapt and self-reconfigure in response to changes in the network topology or outside factors. Because of their versatility, they are suitable for a variety of applications. This paper presents an overview of dynamic networks, covering various aspects such as significant challenges, applications, and classification. Dynamic networks offer an enormous range of possible uses, and future advancements in their design and uses are expected to influence many societal aspects significantly.

articleTitle: Classification of Lung Diseases using Deep Learning Techniques: A Comparative Study of Classification Algorithms
abstract: The significant health impact of lung diseases hampers the life of an individual and his/her family. It is crucial to ensure that everyone lives a healthy life, hence early detection of lung diseases is encouraged at an early stage. As several lung illnesses reduce the life span of people, they are not able to live a healthy life. There are errors in many detection algorithms, so a better algorithm is required to detect such diseases. In this paper, we have discussed lung diseases and how to recognize them. The two primary techniques for identifying lung illness are therefore image processing and deep learning. Deep learning is increasingly emphasized as the preferable method with convolutional neural networks. We further discussed various machine learning algorithms and compared their results with the newly designed algorithm of a convolutional neural network with an autoencoder. There are several approaches described in the literature for classifying medical images. This paper aims to develop a useful tool that will assist medical practitioners in quickly determining if a patient has a lung disease or is at risk of contracting one; by analyzing lung images and examining disease development risk factors with the use of an autoencoder.

articleTitle: Computer-Aided Detection of Nuclei from Histopathology Image: Evaluating the Effectiveness of U-Net and Modified Networks for Nuclei Segmentation
abstract: Computerized segmentation of nuclei from histopathology images is crucial for detecting breast cancer, the most common type of cancer in women. Early detection is key for effective treatment. Pathologists can track cancer by properly segmenting and analyzing nuclei since changes in the morphological characteristics of nuclei can be used as indicators of cancer progression. So, automatic nuclei detection will help pathologists to recognize abnormalities without much physical effort, alleviating the burden of pathologists. Deep learning techniques, such as U-Net, have reported great potential in solving this issue.In this study, we explore the effectiveness of U-Net and the variants of U Net model for nuclei segmentation from histopathology images. We observed that U Net variants that adopt Attention and Residual networks significantly improve intersection-over-union and accuracy (80%) of the baseline U-Net model. We also attempt to create an annotated nuclei mask for the publicly available BreakHis dataset using Attention Residual U-Net. Our results demonstrate that the ground truth generated by the Aattention Residual U Net model is consilient with pathologist’s annotations, promising an effective technique to generate ground truth for dataset lacking annotated nuclei.Overall, our study highlights the potential of deep learning techniques, particularly the Attention Residual U-Net, for automated nuclei segmentation in breast cancer detection. This could improve diagnosis efficiency while reducing human error, especially as computer-aided detection methods become increasingly necessary for precise and automated segmentation of nuclei.

articleTitle: Card Blitz: Memory Retention Football Card Matching Game
abstract: Games are viewed as entertaining activities that promote both mental as well as physical stimulus; They are very advantageous and necessary for kids' intellectual and mental growth. On the other hand, due to the focus and memorizing procedures involved in gaming, it plays a significant role in the growth of human memory. Finding equal pairings of cards among a variety of them is the goal of the memory game, which is a supplement to cognitive development in people. This paper presents an internet web browser-based football-card matching memory game for improving memory retention and cognitive development of children as well as for entertainment. There are several web-based games available out there, and the proposed game also draws inspiration from them. The proposed paper makes an effort to keep user interaction clear and easy because there are not many steps needed to finish a task in the game. The primary goals of the game are to entertain while also enhancing various mental abilities. Many players are drawn to these games because they want to test their memory retention abilities on attractive graphic interfaces. Target users of the game are primarily college and high school kids, but also intrigued grownups. The game is developed using HTML, CSS and Java Script. It consists of a single player interface where the player is required to match the cards of football players under a time limit. In game animations have also been applied to indicate matching cards, flipping of cards along with victory or game-over messages. The components of the proposed web-game are detailed, and the interface of the game is also demonstrated.

articleTitle: Research on the Application and Development of Intelligent Algorithm in the Field of New Media Communication
abstract: Mobile Internet, Internet of things, big data, cloud computing, intelligent human-computer interaction and artificial intelligence algorithms jointly promote the development of current media platforms and systems in the direction of intelligence. In the development process of media intelligence, social information communication system turns to online social information communication system.The application of intelligent algorithm in the field of new media communication is a human-computer interaction (HCI)which uses artificial intelligence (AI)and machine learning to improve user experience.It can be used in various applications, such as social network, search engine optimization, recommendation system and so on.The main advantage of using artificial intelligence in human-computer interaction is that it can help users obtain more relevant information with less effort. When you use AI tools instead of manual processes,the process becomes faster and easier.This can also reduce costs by reducing the labor hours required to achieve the desiredgoals

articleTitle: Privacy-Preserving sensitive data on Medical diagnosis using Federated Learning and Homomorphic Re-encryption
abstract: Federated learning is an emerging technique that allows multiple participants to train a shared model without exchanging their private data. This approach is particularly useful for IoT applications, where data is often collected locally and stored in distributed devices like edge nodes. Privacy concerns arise when using IoT devices to record medical data for distributed learning. Techniques such as differential privacy and federated learning can help ensure data security while preserving privacy. Encryption and secure multi-party computation can also be used to securely share and compute data. By training a model on a combination of data from these devices. In the medical research, federated learning can be used to train models on data from multiple healthcare devices such as wearables, smart medical sensors, and electronic health records. By training models on local data, healthcare providers can improve the accuracy of diagnosis and treatment while protecting patient privacy. Security analysis can involve evaluating the potential vulnerabilities and risks of the system and identifying measures to protect against them. Experimental results can involve testing the performance of the system in terms of accuracy, convergence speed, and other metrics, and comparing it to other methods.

articleTitle: Screening of Baggage X-ray Images Using Convolutional Neural Networks
abstract: For security screening of X-ray baggage, we address the problem as image classification task by the application of trained deep convolutional neural networks (CNN). Large quantities of training data are typically needed when using a deep multi-layer CNN technique to build a complete framework that obtains features and performs screening. To solve this problem, we use a transfer learning methodology that allows a pre-trained CNNs to be particularly tuned later for achieving the classification of baggage. In our study, for the classical threat and non-threat image classification, we experimented the classification task by a newly designed lighter CNN network without pre-training and compared the classification performance of pre-trained neural networks with SVM classifier using the features extracted from various layers of CNNs. Pre-trained networks achieve 99% classification accuracy and precision and exceeds the performance of CNN network without prior training. Further, the classification task by a newly designed lighter CNN network without pre-training achieves 96% accuracy, 95% precision, 5% false positive rate with SVM classifier.

articleTitle: Metaheuristic Evolutionary Algorithms: Types, Applications, Future Directions, and Challenges
abstract: Metaheuristic optimization methods are widely used to solve complex optimization problems in various fields such as engineering, finance, and logistics. Evolutionary Algorithms (EAs) are a family of metaheuristic optimization algorithms that are inspired by biological evolution and natural selection. EAs mimic the process of natural selection by maintaining a population of candidate solutions and applying genetic operators such as mutation, crossover, and selection to generate new solutions over multiple generations. In this review, we will focus on six popular types of EAs: Genetic Algorithms (GA), Evolution Strategies (ES), Genetic Programming (GP), Differential Evolution (DE), Estimation of Distribution Algorithms (EDA), and Cultural Algorithms (CA). The study also provides insights into the selection of appropriate metaheuristic optimization methods for solving specific optimization problems.

articleTitle: Sparse-Attention Based Deep Convolutional Neural Network for Pneumonia Detection
abstract: Pneumonia is a frequent pulmonary disease which has more death rate in infants under age 5. Diagnosis of pneumonia at early stage can result in better treatment. For accurate pneumonia prediction on chest x-rays, we constructed a deep convolutional neural network with sparse-attention in this study. Inorder to improve the performance of Deep CNN’s we have implemented attention module which makes the model robust and generalize well. To extract spatial features from raw input images and turn them into feature vectors, we employed a transfer learning technique. We have introduced sparse attention mechanism on the spatial feature vector. The resultant attention feature vector weigh more information when they are further passed to next layer to MLP head for pneumonia detection. The proposed methodology is experimented on benchmark Kermany dataset. Our experimental studies indicates that attention mechanism to the Deep CNN’s shown significant performance than traditional deep CNN’s. According to experimental studies, the proposed Sparse Attention based model with Convolutional Base followed by attention module surpassed several existing state of art models achieving accuracy of 95.4%. The proposed model’s performance is evaluated on metrics like accuracy, precision, recall, f1-score.

articleTitle: Real-time XSS Vulnerability Detection
abstract: In today’s world, web application attacks have become a major concern as they can lead to unauthorized access to important information and even disruption of online services. In the context of web application attacks, one example is XSS (Cross-site Scripting) attack. These attacks are dangerous because they can steal important information like passwords and credit card details or take users to harmful websites without their knowledge. Therefore, in this paper, a plugin has been designed to classify the websites as vulnerable and alert users on not giving data to the respective page to prevent any data loss or potential cyber-attack. This method produces a true negativity of 74.49%, a true positivity of 8.16%, false negativity of 2.04%, and false positivity of 15.31%.

articleTitle: Predicting the Adsorption Capacity of Organic Compounds Using Neural Network Models
abstract: Carbon materials are crucial to human life. They play a vital role in many industries such as automobile, construction and electronics. These materials are used to make products that have an impact on our daily life. The use of these products leads to the emission of harmful gases into the atmosphere, which leads to global warming and other environmental problems. Therefore, it is important to find environmentally sound alternative sources of raw materials. The pore structure of the adsorbent has a significant impact on the recovery and utilization of volatile organic compounds (VOCs). The traditional screening method of activated carbon requires not only the characterization of pore structure, but also the experimental determination of the working capacity of the corresponding sample to adsorb n-butane. In order to improve the screening efficiency of activated carbon, combined with the characterization information of 61 kinds of activated carbon, the classification model of activated carbon based on BP neural network was regressed by machine learning, and the average deviation between the calculated results of the studied activated carbon adsorbing n-butane working capacity and the experimental value was about 6.64%. The quantitative relationship between the characteristic parameters of activated carbon and the adsorbing n-butane working capacity was successfully established, which has important research significance for reducing the experimental cost.

articleTitle: Transliteration from Hindi to English Using Image Processing
abstract: Transliteration is the process of changing a word or a text from one script to another while keeping the phonetic and orthographic features of the source language. Transliteration is an important part of natural language processing, especially for communicating with people who speak different languages. This paper focuses on the transliteration of the Hindi language into the English language, as Hindi is the official language of India and there is a huge amount of data in Hindi that must be translated into English for regional and global use. It is essential to transliterate Hindi into English so that speakers of other languages can comprehend and communicate in Hindi. This paper describes a hybrid approach for transliteration from Hindi to English that includes image processing and a model trained with attention, as well as its applications in diverse fields. The system is evaluated using a dataset of Hindi text images, and the outcomes show that the proposed method improves existing transliteration systems in both, accuracy and speed.

articleTitle: Credit Card Fraud Detection using Neural Embeddings and Radial Basis Network with a novel hybrid fruitfly-fireworks algorithm
abstract: Financial institutions are highly concerned about credit card fraud due to the growing frequency of deceitful activities linked with credit card transactions. To address this issue, a novel fraud detection system is proposed that combines advanced feature engineering and neural network architecture. The proposed approach. FFFW-RBN, employs a hybrid swarm intelligence model comprising the Fruitfly Optimization Algorithm and Fireworks Algorithm, (FFO-FWA) for feature selection, and the Neural Embeddings Generator in combination with a Shallow Radial Basis Network (RBF) for localized pattern classification. The proposed system achieves a 99.97% accuracy, 0.91 recall, and a precision of 0.94. The experimental results demonstrate that our methodology effectively and practically detects fraudulent credit card transactions. The paper presents a comprehensive evaluation of the system, including various performance metrics and a confusion matrix, highlighting its potential for real-world implementation.

articleTitle: The Construction of Intelligent Classroom for Blended Teaching of Cognitive Load and College English Spoken Language Based on Data Mining
abstract: Building an intelligent classroom that combines cognitive load and college English teaching is a key step in improving students' learning experience. Blended learning combines traditional face-to-face teaching with online learning, creating a more flexible and interactive learning environment. The use of technology in the classroom can help reduce cognitive load and enable students to focus on understanding complex concepts. Intelligent classrooms should be equipped with modern technologies such as interactive whiteboards, projectors, and audio-visual aids to facilitate the delivery of course content. In addition, the use of artificial intelligence can provide tailored feedback and suggestions based on the individual needs of each student, thereby helping them personalize their learning experience. Incorporating blended learning into college English courses can also provide opportunities for real language use through online communication tools, thereby improving language acquisition. This method can help students develop language skills in real life while reducing cognitive load. In short, building an intelligent classroom for blended learning is an important step in improving the quality of higher education. It provides an opportunity to integrate technology into traditional teaching methods, creating a more attractive and effective learning experience for students.

articleTitle: A Comparative Study on Different Machine Learning Techniques in Diabetes Risk Assessment
abstract: Diabetes is a chronic disease in which the body’s ability to process glucose is impaired due to insufficient insulin production or utilization. This can result in high blood sugar levels and other health issues. Since the majority of our country’s population are not conscious about their lifestyle and are unaware of the complications and casualties that diabetes can lead to if it is not examined timely, assessing their risk for diabetes is an important step in prevention and early detection. Assessing one’s diabetes risk prior to medical diagnosis is crucial to enable timely intervention and management of the disease. Our paper intends to provide such a solution that would help detect the disease risk beforehand. We selected two diabetes datasets: PIMA Indian and Sylhet dataset for evaluating ten different models, namely-Support Vector Machine, Random Forest, Naive Bayes, Decision Tree, K Nearest Neighbor, Logistic Regression, Adaboost, Gradient Boost, XGBoost, and Multilayer perceptron. We applied Grid Search and Stratified K-fold cross-validation to asses model’s performance. Our goal is to determine the best-performing model for predicting diabetes. From the analysis, Random Forest outperformed in PIMA Indian Dataset with 84.21% accuracy and Gradient Boost outperformed in Sylhet dataset with 98.85% accuracy. So, for the two different featured datasets Random Forest and Gradient Boost scored highest as the best-predicting models.

articleTitle: Image-based Classification of Skin Cancer using Convolution Neural Network
abstract: Skin cancer is a category or collection of cancer affecting the tissues and layers of skin. Skin cancer is classified into several types depending on the type of cell it affects. These types include melanoma, melanocytic nevus, basal cell carcinoma, benign keratosis, actinic keratosis, dermatofibroma, vascular lesion, and squamous cell carcinoma. Melanoma which affects the melanocytes and is considered to be the most fatal and deadly cancer, is growing at an alarming rate, especially in the western hemisphere and the Pacific region. The proposed system contained a web-based application where the image of an affected skin area can be uploaded and the likelihood of skin cancer is displayed. This system has used a convoluted neural network (CNN) based binary and multi-classification model making efficient use of image processing, computer vision, OpenCV, and Python to classify dermatoscopic lesion images into cancerous and non-cancerous along with their types. The implemented binary classifier achieves an accuracy of 92%. Further, the multi-class classification model is implemented based on CNN to classify dermatoscopic cancerous lesion images into nine types which achieved an accuracy of 97%. Among nine classes one of the classes is non-cancerous. The models aim to provide a means of diagnostic tool that will help in the preliminary diagnosis of skin lesions. Early detection and diagnosis are appropriate measures to combat the spread and lethality of skin cancer.

articleTitle: Application Research of Machine Vision Platform Based on Ant Colony Algorithm and Software Engineering
abstract: The research on the application of machine vision platform based on ant colony algorithm and software engineering is aimed at the application of machine vision platform based on ant colony algorithm and software engineering. The main purpose of this study is to identify applications that can be developed using our proposed system. In order to better understand, we conducted a survey of colleagues from different universities and institutes to understand their feedback on this topic. We have collected information from them about their views on this project. It includes the following steps: 1. Design the system architecture and analyze its performance; 2. Develop necessary algorithms to achieve the expected results; 3. Implement the developed algorithm into the actual system with real-time requirements; 4. Analyze and test the implementation results of the algorithm in the actual system; 5. Improve or modify the existing algorithm to improve its performance and achieve the efficiency of the expected results; 6. Test new versions of existing or newly developed algorithms to improve their performance or efficiency.

articleTitle: A Transition of Face Recognition to Mask Face Recognition Using Improvised Attention DL Model
abstract: With the emergence of the communicable fatal Covid-19 virus and increased level of air pollution, every individual is adapting to wear a facial mask now a days, due to which the existing Face Recognition Models are experiencing reduction in accuracy rate. The study in this paper is aimed to analyze the rate of drop in test accuracy for the task of face recognition from normal face recognition to the recognition of masked faces. Also, it targets to analyze the behavior of Convolution Block Attention mechanism with 10 different deep learning architectures as trunk branch. This paper discusses a novel idea to generate a sample space for training by various combinations of original face images, simulated masked faces and augmentation, from the original 2 datasets which improves the test accuracy of the models. The combination of InceptionV3+CBAM proves to be the best model with the peak accuracy of 88.78% & 88.62% and least model’s inference time of 512 & 923 milliseconds on Yale and Casia subset datset respectively among all other 9 implemented attention models. Moreover the proposed implementation of InceptionV3+CBAM also succeeds to achieve better accuracy as compared to existing models by using proposed set of dataset (Original face Images+ Simulated Mask faces+Augmentation) type for training.

articleTitle: Siamese Network Based Anomaly Detection Framework for Robust Federated Learning
abstract: Federated learning is a decentralized approach to machine learning that has increased in popularity in recent years. It enables several participants to train a common model without revealing their data. This strategy is, however, susceptible to attacks from malicious clients who can launch targeted model poisoning attacks and reduce learning performance by delivering false model updates to the server. It is necessary to identify and eliminate such fraudulent updates and the attackers behind them to preserve the robustness and security of the shared model. In this paper, a novel Siamese network-based architecture for robust federated learning is proposed. which can identify and eliminate harmful updates. Our method is assessed and compared with other approaches for adversarial detection in image classification tasks in a federated setting, using a CNN model. Experimental findings demonstrate that the system offers reliable federated learning that is resistant to both targeted model poisoning and untargeted Byzantine attacks. Overall, the study advances the development of secure federated learning systems, by suggesting a novel method for identifying and deleting fraudulent updates in federated learning,

articleTitle: Braking in Electrical Vehicle for Control of heat flow
abstract: Electric vehicles use regenerative braking systems that convert the vehicle’s kinetic energy into electrical energy that is stored in the battery for later use. However, one issue that can arise with regenerative braking systems is overheating, which can lead to reduced braking performance or even complete brake failure. This is because regenerative braking systems generate a large amount of heat when they convert kinetic energy into electrical energy. If the heat generated exceeds the capacity of the braking system to dissipate it, then the brakes can become less effective or even fail. To prevent this from happening, electric vehicles are typically equipped with cooling systems to help dissipate the heat generated during regenerative braking. These cooling systems may use air or liquid to cool the brakes and prevent them from overheating. This work give the brief overview of strategies used to limit the heat flow.

articleTitle: "MindScape Jr: Cognitive well-being analysis system for young minds"
abstract: Mental health is a crucial component of an individual's emotional, psychological, and social well- being. In recent years, there has been a growing concern about the increasing number of mental health issues, and the COVID-19 pandemic has only exacerbated the situation. It is essential to monitor one's mental health regularly and seek professional help, if necessary, especially in children and tweens since those are the ages where we get affected the most. To address this issue, we propose a cognitive well-being analysis system for young minds, which aims to track and quantify various cognitive associations and emotive responses in children aged 10-15 years. we propose a mobile application that uses a simplistic user interface for easy navigation and real-time monitoring to assess real-time emotional well-being and provides suggestions for seeking professional help if necessary. The application includes a chatbot that behaves like a close friend and engages the user in positive conversations. The chatbot suggests hobbies and activities, detects unusual activities of the user, and provides emergency contacts and a rescue plan in case of emergencies. This application can help individuals improve their emotional well-being through conversations with a human-like chatbot all the while helping users cope with growing mental health concerns and help them lead a healthier lifestyle.

articleTitle: A Comparative Analysis of the Brain Lobes and Feature Techniques in the Detection of Emotion
abstract: The role of emotions in our daily lives is of great importance as they have a significant impact on our behaviour and interactions with others. Numerous attempts and research have been undertaken to classify EEG signals for emotion detection. This study presents a multi-class classification of four emotions, namely happy, sad, neutral, and fear, using various classifiers, along with 5- and 10-folds cross-validation methods. To evaluate which lobe shows the highest accuracy, four lobes of the brain, namely frontal, temporal, parietal, and occipital, were compared by selecting electrodes based on their positions in the brain. The results demonstrate that the parietal lobe resulted in the highest accuracy of 96.9% with 10-fold cross-validation using Fine KNN classifier, while the temporal lobe showed the lowest accuracy of 89.8% with 5-folds cross-validation using Fine KNN classifier. Four commonly used performance metrics (accuracy, recall, precision and F1-score) have been used to evaluate the accuracy and effectiveness of the model. Conducted a comparison between the feature extraction methods using Differential Entropy (DE) and Power Spectral Density (PSD) techniques. One study stated that the highest level of accuracy, at 98.4%, was achieved using data that had been processed using DE features, compared to data processed using PSD features, or a combination of both DE and PSD features. The best-performing algorithms were Fine KNN, Cubic SVM, Fine Gaussian SVM, Weighted KNN, and Ensembled Bagged Trees model. This study highlights the potential of using EEG signals and machine learning algorithms to accurately recognize emotions, which can have applications in various fields such as psychology and neuroscience.

articleTitle: DeEN: Deep Ensemble Framework for Neuroatypicality Classification
abstract: This paper proposes a Machine Learning (ML) based ensemble framework to identify neuroatypicality among individuals. The focus of this study is neuroatypicality, which refers to individuals who suffer from irregular neurological functioning. The neuroatypicality conditions includes ASD, ADHD and Dyslexia. The neuroatypical individuals face challenges in emotional regulation, educational intervention, decision-making, and problem-solving. Diagnosis of neuroatypicality is a difficult task due to the varied symptoms among individuals. Brain signal analysis is one of the common parameters to identify neuroatypicality. This paper focuses on brain signal based ML framework to classify the typically and neuroatypically developed individuals. The contribution of this paper is to propose an ensemble framework for early diagnosis of neuro disorder which forms a basis to enable Artificial Intelligence (AI) to generate heuristics for further academic and medical research.

articleTitle: Predicting Breast Cancer An Evaluation of Machine Learning Approaches
abstract: A disease in which the cells of the breast have uncontrollable growth or cancer cell growth in the breast is known as breast-related cancer. There are various types of uncontrollable growth. In women, it is most common cancer which accounts for around 25 percent of all cancers diagnosed in women. According to the 3rd of February 2023, departmental news of WHO, every year, more than 2.3 million new instances of breast cancer are identified. Breast cancer is one of the major causes of female deaths in 95% of countries. Early diagnosis of BC can decrease the death rate drastically as it is a curable disease when diagnosed in early stages. The classification of diagnosed breast cancer into malignant or benign tumor is a major field of research at present. Use of ML in diagnosis and classification of breast cancer is widely recognized due to its powerful feature in detection from BC datasets. This paper will evaluate various ML techniques such as regression, support vector machines (SVMs), DTs naive Bayes and random forest in the classification and diagnosis of breast cancer. We have used Wisconsin breast cancer diagnosis (WBCD) dataset for paper. A health care system model is also presented along with this paper.

Implementing Three Factors Authentication System (3FA) to Maintain Employee Attendance Record to Enhance Security
abstract: Today as we all know that maintaining of employee credential have been some major issues around the world. Finding it more difficult to keep track of employees. With this, the company, institution, or government entity does not know who has entered their work-spaces to steal important information from their systems or databases. This serves as a deep wound for any company that does not keep track of its employees. This has been a major issue within so many Africans country, most especially Liberia. where so many companies, institutions, and governmental entities losing huge amounts of data. The means by which they do not track employee records have been with the traditional sign-in method, which has to do with the pen and paper or book sign in and sign out method, which can easily be stolen or damaged. This is one of the methods that employees use to not sign in when they get to work in order to steal data without anyone knowing that they were at work that day. Coming up with a method that will enable strong security and secure maintenance of employees records with less consuming and a strong level of three-factor authentication (3FA) will enable all employees to sign in with their three-level credentials, which have to do with something you know (knowledge), something you have (possession), or something you are (Inherence).The trustworthiness of identification is increased because this data cannot be copied or hacked. Furthermore, Three (3) Factor Authentication attempts to demonstrate, from a broader perspective, why it is more important to review your security procedures in order to prevent unauthorized persons from gaining access to your systems and obtaining data and information that you have not provided them with. Our system is going to allow user signing in with their user credential on your system after entering your username and password which authenticate you into the system, you as an employee to be verified and attendance to be mark you will use your Face, recognizing you and comparing it to the data stored with in the database for verification, after than been verified and mark your attendance for the day. This method going to be used is less time consuming and low cost attached.

articleTitle: Travelling Chatbot Using Android Application
abstract: In the majority of cases, a user of an Android application either receives the expected outcomes or receives unsatisfactory results. The paper's major objectives are to automate communication through the use of chatbots and to make hotel searching simple and convenient for system users. Creating a chatbot using android will help user to find out the different locations, and famous food available in different locations. Also, this system will identify the current weather of the different locations. Extensive research on existing systems demonstrated faults that the system attempts to address by creating a chatbot with the use of a Dialogue flow library and a number of algorithms, including String Similarity, Natural language parser, Spellchecker, and Keyword Matching. The implementation of this system has allowed for improving the use of resources and the reactivity of users. This system has been set up to incorporate all information about the hotel, food, weather information, and a lot more information.

articleTitle: Reinforcement Learning-Based Bonobo Optimizer for Efficient Load Balancing in Cloud Computing
abstract: The field of optimization has undergone a paradigm shift with the advent of reinforcement learning techniques, which are widely used for solving complex problems in various domains. In this paper, we propose a novel optimization algorithm, called the Bonobo Optimization. The algorithm is inspired by the social behaviour of Bonobo apes, which are known for their collaborative and communicative behaviour. This algorithm is designed to learn from its interactions with the environment and adapt to new situations, making it a robust and adaptive optimization tool. We demonstrate the effectiveness on several benchmark optimization problems, where it outperforms them.

articleTitle: Compressive Sensing of Natural Images with Hybrid Transform based Sensing Matrix
abstract: The modern transformation has resulted in the creation of different sensing systems with precision and effectiveness. Compressive sensing (CS) is a conventional technique for sensing of data information during data capture and compression. The measurement matrix, sensing matrix and recovery technique are the most difficult aspects of CS. The proposed system uses a hybrid transform for sensing matrix, which lowers image matrix processing complexity. The various transform matrices like Discrete Cosine Transform (DCT), Haar Matrix Transform (HMT), Slant Matrix Transform (SMT) and Fast Walsh Hadamard Transform (FWHT) are considered for the Hybrid transform operation. The recovery of image is carried with recovery algorithms like Compressive Sampling Matching Pursuit (CoSaMP), and Orthogonal Matching Pursuit(OMP). The image recovery with the proposed technique has a higher image quality. The different images are assessed with full reference image based on the parameters of PSNR, SNR and SSIM the results show better quality on recovered image and less complexity. The results PSNR of 24.2214 and MSE 246.0058 for cattle1 and 23.9998 and 258.8831 for cattle2.

articleTitle: Wearable CPW Antenna for WBAN Applications
abstract: This paper presents a CPW (co-planar waveguide) antenna based on an EBG (electromagnetic bandgap) and FSS (frequency selective surface) design operating at 2.4GHz frequency for WBAN (Wireless Body Area Network) applications. The proposed system includes a CPW-fed antenna incorporated with a 2x2 EBG-FSS array which reduces the backward radiation, overcomes the omnidirectional pattern of antenna alone, and improves efficiency. The dimensions of the complete design are 65x65x2.4 mm3. The study is analyzed using the Ansys HFSS software. The antenna along with the EBG-FSS structure resonates at 2.4 GHz frequency, which is the ideal frequency for an ISM band antenna. It results in a gain of 3.04 dB, with a -34 dB S11 return loss. The SAR (Specific Absorption Rate) is measured to be of only 0.522 W/Kg, which is well below the standard rate. Measurements and simulations show good agreement in most cases. Thus, the design is fit for WBAN applications.

articleTitle: The Cognitive Load Based on Language Big Data and the Construction of Intelligent Classroom for College Oral English Mixed Teaching
abstract: Oral English course is one of the most important courses for English majors. It is also a practical and practical course. However, the English education at the university stage pays more attention to the written test results, so the students' ability to write questions is more prominent, and their oral expression ability is relatively weak. It is an effective teaching method to construct an intelligent classroom in the mixed teaching of college oral English. It can be used as a method to improve students' oral ability and also as a tool to learn new languages. The main idea of this method is that students must communicate through speech, writing or listening, which will help them improve their communication skills and make them more confident in their oral ability.

articleTitle: Improved P300-Based BCI using EEG Scalogram Images and Deep Neural Networks
abstract: Advances in Brain-Computer Interfaces (BCIs) enable persons to control physical devices and applications using their brain signals. One common approach to designing BCI systems is to use the P300 response, a positive deflection in the EEG waveform that occurs after a relevant stimulus is presented. In this paper, we propose an improved P300-based BCI using EEG scalogram images and Deep Neural Networks (DNNs). EEG scalograms is a spectrum of the EEG signals, which are used to extract relevant features for detecting P300 responses. DNNs are capable of learning complex patterns in data, making them well-suited for analyzing EEG scalogram images. We present a five-step process for building and evaluating a P300-based BCI using EEG scalogram images and DNNs. Our proposed approach promises improved accuracy and robustness in detecting P300 responses, which can enable individuals with disabilities to control devices and applications with greater ease and efficiency.

articleTitle: Facilitating Cryptocurrency Analysis and Watchlist Management with a Web-Based Platform
abstract: Cryptocurrencies are digital assets built on blockchain technology, known for their high volatility and lack of underlying assets to justify their intrinsic value. The trading and investing in cryptocurrencies heavily rely on price trends and a few supporting parameters. To facilitate cryptocurrency analysis, our platform provides a price chart that showcases the current short-term, medium-term, and long-term trends of each currency. This analysis is supported by additional parameters such as market capitalization, 24-hour percentage-wise price change, and concise information about each element.Moreover, with the wide array of cryptocurrencies available, individuals struggle to maintain a watchlist that reflects their prioritized selection. To address this challenge, we have developed a priority watchlist that assists users in both short-term trading and long-term investing. Our solution is web-based and utilizes various methodologies including an Application Programming Interface (API) for data retrieval, a library for displaying price charts, and an algorithm for implementing the priority watchlist functionality.

articleTitle: Blockchain Based e-Voting System
abstract: Voting is one of the fundamental rights of any citizen and conducting a voting is a very tedious process as a lot of manpower is required, important arrangement is required and above all a belief that a person’s vote is safely casted. On a website there are two options: login and registration (for new users). At the time of registration user data is verified and stored in the database. Entire Database required for the voting system is managed by using the XAMPP server and data will be stored in the associated database. After successful login on the website the user will have to fill a KYC form which will store important information about the user. Ethereum is used for implementation of blockchain and for coding purposes solidity is used. Gas value is generated for each block (for each candidate), this assigned gas value is unique and equal for all the blocks initially. For each new vote some gas value gets spent and the counter gets incremented. These gas values can only be seen by the main developer.

articleTitle: Analysis of Beamforming Performance in 5G Communication
abstract: This paper sheds light on the beamforming in 5G communication and improvements being done which are limiting the enlargement of routers bandwidth. The paper points to the importance of routers and beamforming technology in the fifth generation of communication that we currently live in as massive MIMO beamforming is the backbone of the 5G communication. Beamforming is the use of numerous radiating elements to produce a single aerial with a longer, more focused stream by focusing the waves in a particular direction. Each radiating element transmits the same signal at the same wavelength and phase. The antenna's beam becomes narrower as it has more radiating components. While analogue beamforming in the RF domain can offer aerial benefits that lessen the lossy character of 5G signals, digital beamforming at the baseband processor is now the most often employed method.

articleTitle: Testing Significance of Layout Dependent Impacts on Silicon Chips Performance
abstract: Layout Dependent Effects (LDE) plays a vital role in layout of analog and digital circuits. These effects are directly affects the performance of the integrated circuits. If you did not pay any attention to the layout dependent effects, then there is a less chance to get the proper performance of the chips. There are many layout dependent effects such as Shallow Trench Isolation (STI), Length of Diffusion (LoD), Poly and Diffusion spacing, Well Proximity Effect (WPE) etc. In this paper, more attention is given to the above topics. Engineers typically must perform a variety of checks that cover these and related layout issues to ensure analog layout consistency.

articleTitle: Automatic Detection Method of Operation Error of Smart Electricity Meter Based on Machine Vision
abstract: In order to improve the detection effect and reduce the number of electricity theft, an automatic detection method of operation error of intelligent electricity meter based on machine vision is proposed. Firstly, the smart meter image is collected, the Otsu threshold binarization method is used to extract the pulse lamp area image, and the improved lifting wavelet and morphology are used to preprocess the area image. Then, the pulse lamp in the reconstructed image is segmented by projection combined with a priori knowledge feedback method, and the template matching method is used to automatically detect whether the segmented pulse lamp is on, Finally, the experimental results show that this method can effectively detect the meter operation error under different line loss and power factor, effectively reduce the occurrence times of power theft, and has high detection accuracy. When different image brightness, this method has high dice value and high segmentation effect quality.

articleTitle: Optical Design and Modeling of Micro Light Emitting Diodes for Display Applications
abstract: Recently, there has been a lot of interest in μ-LED technology, because of its exceptional qualities, including auto emission, high visibility, low consumption of power, rapid response and longevity. Light-emitting diode (LED) using III-nitride, such as lighting sources, visible light communication (VLC) devices, and high-power devices, are finding increasing use as miniaturization technology advances. The use of micro-LEDs displays in place of traditional display technologies like liquid crystal displays (LCDs) and organic light-emitting diode (OLEDs) is one of the most prominent recent advances, which may even represent the next generation of displays. The development of fully integrated, multifunctional devices and the incorporation of extra capabilities into micro-LED displays, such as sensing, light detection, and solar cells, are the pillars of advanced technology. Due to the wide range of applications for micro-LED technology, the effectiveness and dependability of these devices in numerous harsh conditions are becoming increasingly important. Enough research has been conducted to overcome the under-effectiveness of micro-LED devices. In this paper, A different Micro LED design structures are proposed and grating is introduced in order to achieve optimized optical properties. In order to attain improved external quantum efficiency (EQE), devices' light extraction efficiency (LEE) has also been boosted.

articleTitle: Secure Data Dissemination in Wireless Sensor Networks with The Help of Module Based Blockchain Technology
abstract: Wireless Sensor is small, limited energy storage capacity and also using for wide variety of application. Due to its limited power and storage capacities, it is required to collect the data from the sensed nodes. The nodes present in the network are always busy with sensing and transmitting the data towards Base Station with the help of several hoping. Here it is required for secure data transmission for increasing the wireless sensor network quality of service. In this paper, we discuss how we can ensure secure data transmission between the nodes in WSN using Blockchain. We examine a Blockchain-based WSN architecture that offers a distributed network that primarily addresses the privacy and security issues during data transfer between the nodes. By producing unique blocks for each node along the routing path excluding the dead nodes and combining these blocks using the hashing method to convey data between the sender and destination nodes, we adopt Blockchain technology for the WSN network.

articleTitle: Data-Driven Predictive Analysis of Global Temperature Changes with Deep Learning
abstract: With growing concerns over rising carbon emissions and global temperatures, there is a pressing need for addressing climate change. As the repercussions of climate change are severe – such as acidification of oceans and extreme weather, it is integral to identify the key contributors leading to the problem to effectively combat it. In this paper, we intend to model the temperatures of specific regions towards predicting the future trends in temperature by leveraging historical data, and thus address global warming. We aim to utilize a data-driven approach to analyze integral parameters such as land surface temperature, ocean surface temperature, percentage change in temperature over the years etc., and use the inference as a basis to interpret the variations in climate policies/climate actions in tackling climate change. We leverage a network of Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) – a popular deep learning model, for time-series forecasting of global temperature changes. This is coupled with a comprehensive analysis of the model’s predictions based on multiple data mining techniques. Comparison of the LSTM’s performance with the rolling mean baseline model shows that based on temperature changes, 19% of areas across the planet suffer from extreme climatic conditions. This affects the average temperature of the globe drastically. In future, we aim to refine our analysis based on larger datasets and generalize the outcomes of other factors playing a role in climate change beyond global temperature changes.

articleTitle: Research on Road Traffic State Discrimination Technology based on RFID Electronic License Plate
abstract: The research focus of RFID technology based on license plate is to improve service quality, reduce traffic accidents and improve road safety. It has been proved that RFID based technology can be used to improve traffic control and reduce congestion in urban areas. The main goal of this research is to develop a new vehicle recognition system, which will provide more accurate vehicle information than the current system, and can recognize them even if they park or move slowly. This will allow better monitoring and management of urban traffic flow, thereby reducing accidents and vehicle pollution.It is part of the "intelligent transportation road traffic management system" project, which aims to develop a system that can automatically identify vehicles registered in different states or regions. The system uses radio frequency identification (RFID) for automatic toll collection systems at many border crossings across Japan, as well as other applications.

articleTitle: A Machine Learning Based Melanoma Skin Cancer using Hybrid Texture Features
abstract: There is a great rise in patients afflicted with the disease Melanoma, the most unpredictable and potentially fatal cancer. If treated in time, the fatality rate can be reduced significantly in most cases. Active Melanoma discovery in the incipient stage is difficult to recognize. As the availability of qualified dermatologists is scarce, a computerized automated method of finding Melanoma accurately is urgently needed. The aforementioned research aims to accomplish this by using supervised machine learning algorithms that are capable of accurately identifying and classifying melanoma to separate skin lesions from the images collected from the combined dataset of the ISIC archive and the PH2 dermoscopic images. For segmenting the tumor portion, the Otsu Thresholding algorithm is employed. The segmented images are applied to a preprocessing network to extract features of ABCD, GLCM, LBP and Histogram of Gradients (HG). Later, these features are trained with different supervised classifiers to generate the model. Later the test data is fed to the model to obtain the predictive labels. The results of the proposed skin melanoma detection prove that skin melanoma detection with XGBoost provides superior results compared to the existing works in the literature.

articleTitle: Root Locus Analysis for Swinging Up and Stabilizing Inverted Pendulum Cart System
abstract: The paper presents swinging up and stabilization of inverted pendulum cart system (IPCS) and analysis of applied controller via root locus method. The IPCS is highly non-linear system which is analysed by the response after application of impulse input to the system. The controller which has combined feature of linear quadratic regulator (LQR) and conventional PID is proposed to handle the system. The root locus are drawn with and without application of the conventional PID and proposed controllers. It reveals that after application of controller, the roots shift towards left hand side (LHS) which are shown via root locus method. Initially, the system is merely controlled with conventional controller and then after LQR is incorporated in the feedback to control the system. The time specifications result are calculated and compared. The results reveal that the controller which is composed with PID and LQR shows better results as compared to the merely application of PID controller. The disturbance effect is also presented to show performance of the proposed controller. A number of simulated waveforms e.g. cart position and pendulum angle response are presented to show controller’s performance.

articleTitle: Research on Prefabricated Building Quality Management System Based on Internet of Things
abstract: The prefabricated building quality management system based on the Internet of things is a new concept in the construction field. Its development utilizes the latest technologies, such as the Internet and intelligent equipment, which can be used for monitoring, control and communication to improve the quality of prefabricated buildings. The main objective behind the project is to provide better building management through the use of Internet of things technology. This will help us monitor the condition of the building at any time and help us take quick action in case of any problems in the building.. The key points of this study include: the application of Internet of things technology in architecture; Design and implement Internet of things based solutions for building quality management; And evaluate the performance of this solution.

articleTitle: A Mental Health Performance Assessment using Support Vector Machine
abstract: In this paper, the support vector machine (SVM) was used to assess mental health performance using the Open Sourcing Mental Illness (OSMI) in Tech Survey 2019 dataset. To improve the SVM’s performance, data pre-processing was performed using feature scaling, and an autoencoder was utilized as a feature representation for classification tasks. Different combinations of kernel types and gamma values were used with the SVM for performance assessment. The kernel types used included polynomial, sigmoid, radial basis function (RBF), Bessel, and ANOVA. The findings indicated that in the case of the RBF kernel, SVM outperformed other kernels. The average variation in accuracy with different split ratios is approximately between 91%-95%. The minor variations observed in accuracy across different split ratios suggest that the model is robust and can generalize well to new data. It shows the effectiveness of the approach in modeling complex relationships between input features and output labels. This study also highlights the importance of appropriate parameter tuning for the optimal performance.

articleTitle: Sarcasm Detection on News Headline Dataset Using Language Models
abstract: Mechanized detection of sarcasm in textual data is a challenging task in NLP, as it involves recognizing the opposite of what is actually meant. This has become important today since many artificial intelligence tasks require understanding the user and answering appropriately. In this paper, we investigate multiple deep learning models for sarcasm detection on a news headline dataset, including BiLSTM and BERT. For the first time, hybrid BERT models have been used in our study to identify sarcasm in non-social media writings. The results show that the BERT and GBDT strategy combined performs better than all the other strategies listed.

articleTitle: A Supply Chain Management Framework and Relationship Visualizations For Revenue Prediction
abstract: This research aims to predict revenue and find factors that contribute to sales by analysing and visualising a dataset containing numerous customer and order-related characteristics. To create predictive models, the project employs machine learning methods such as CatBoost and LightGBM, as well as visualisations such as heatmaps and distribution plots. The results of the study have implications for businesses and organisations seeking to improve their sales and revenue streams. Businesses can prioritise their marketing and sales activities and allocate resources more effectively by finding the most significant aspects that contribute to sales and income. Furthermore, the predictive models created for this project can be utilised to forecast future sales and revenue, offering useful insights for strategic planning and decision-making. This research emphasises the importance of data analysis and machine learning in comprehending complicated business data, as well as the potential benefits of utilizing these techniques to improve sales and revenue outcomes.

articleTitle: Image Forgery Detection using CNN
abstract: With the increasing use of digital images in various applications, the problem of image forgery has become more prevalent than ever. In this paper, we propose a novel image forgery detection system based on Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) that can detect various types of image manipulations, including copy-move, splicing, and retouching. Our proposed system integrates Error Level Analysis (ELA) with deep learning techniques to provide a more accurate and reliable solution to the problem of image forgery detection. We evaluated the proposed system on a dataset of real-world images and achieved a high detection accuracy of 93%. Our system outperformed existing methods for image forgery detection and demonstrated its potential for various applications, including forensics, security, and digital image analysis. Overall, the proposed CNN-based image forgery detection system offers a robust and effective solution to the growing problem of image manipulation and forgery in today's visual media landscape.

articleTitle: Fire Detection using Transfer Learning and Pre-Trained Model
abstract: In recent years, there has been a rise in the occurrence of fire outbreaks, posing a significant threat to both natural resources and human lives. Consequently, the significance of fire detection in safeguarding human life and property has become increasingly crucial. Various studies have employed sensors and machine learning algorithms for fire detection, with CNN emerging as one of the most promising approaches in this field. The aim of this research paper is to explore the efficacy of using pre-trained CNN models, including VGG16, VGG19, MobileNet, and InceptionV3, through transfer learning to enhance the accuracy of the fire detection classification task. The models were trained on a dataset of 600 images and tested on 250 images, collected from various online sources and sorted into Fire and Non-Fire categories. Our findings indicate that the use of transfer learning in fire detection task yields higher accuracy than the base model. Especially, the modified VGG16, VGG19, MobileNet, and InceptionV3 models achieved 98%, 96%, 85%, and 75% accuracy respectively. This emphasizes the significance of leveraging pre-trained models through transfer learning techniques, which can substantially enhance the performance of the fire detection classification task, even when using a small dataset.

articleTitle: Forecasting Power Consumption by Deep Learning Approaches in the State of Telangana
abstract: Electricity is a vital part of modern life and important for the world economy. India is the third-largest producer of electricity in the world. There is a need to conduct continuous research on forecasting power consumption to meet the demand for overall increased consumption in various sectors. This research will enable policymakers to plan. In need of this research, an analysis was done to forecast electricity consumption. We have used the traditional and newly developed advanced models to predict the accuracy values. A traditional model like ARIMA and distinguished techniques Long Short Term Memory (LSTM) and Convolution Neural Network (CNN) have been used to forecast power consumption demand with a certain degree of accuracy between the years 2014-22. The analysis fits well with the data for LSTM showing an optimal fit than ARIMA and CNN for the observed data considered over eight years in the Industrial-HT sector of power consumption in Telangana State Southern Power Distribution Company Limited.

articleTitle: Facial Recognition and Machine Learning-based Student Attendance Monitoring System
abstract: AI-based student monitoring system provides an innovative approach that enables schools and institutions to monitor student attendance performance and behavior. By utilizing cutting-edge technologies like face recognition, the system makes it easier for teachers to keep track of students' attendance while also giving administrators useful information. The technology automatically logs student attendance, doing away with the necessity for manual human attendance taking. Each student's attendance rate is determined, and the attendance analysis is made available. Administrators can more easily identify students with strong or poor attendance records thanks to the visualization module of the system, which presents attendance data as a graphical representation. Administrators can use this function to ensure that students attend classes on a regular basis. Additionally, the system notifies students and their parents through email when a particular level of attendance is not met, encouraging students to improve their attendance by taking appropriate action and fostering accountability. The AI-based student monitoring system is a useful tool for teachers and students. It helps to raise academic attainment by promoting an accountability and attendance culture in organizations and institutions. The system also provides administrators with useful data and minimizes the effort for educators.

articleTitle: From Clicks to Carts: Developing an Autonomous E-Grocery Shopping System
abstract: Our research initiative, the Autonomous E-Grocery Shopping System with Machine Learning, is centered on the creation of an autonomous grocery shopping experience. One of the main predicaments with online shopping is the lack of personalization and support that is typically offered during in-person shopping. In physical supermarkets, products that are often purchased together are grouped together, incentivizing consumers to buy more and consequently increasing sales. We have incorporated this concept into our e-grocery shopping system to develop a platform that recommends items to users that they may not have been aware they needed. Our research focuses on the crucial role of autonomous artificial intelligence, with an all-encompassing assessment of various state-of-the-art techniques employed in the development of autonomous AI. Through our work, we have created a robust recommendation model utilizing the Apriori Algorithm of association rule mining, and Collaborative Filtering with the Nearest Neighbor’s algorithm. We have identified four major use cases, which include recommending grocery items based on users’ past purchase history, purchase history of similar users, similar items in the users’ cart, and recommending the highest-rated grocery items. We have also created a customized dataset and supported our model using a web application. The average value of support, confidence and lift for all the association rules are 0.001580, 0.124178, and 4.220583 respectively.

Author Keywords: apriori algorithm of association rule mining

articleTitle: Switchable Wideband phase Gradient Beam Steering Reflector/Absorber for Applications such as Intelligent Reflecting Surfaces
abstract: A miniaturized dual functional phase gradient meta-structure for beam steering and simultaneous RCS reduction is proposed in this work. A unit cell is designed, which generates a complete phase profile from -90° to 90° to direct the incident beam in all directions. The novelty in the proposed work is that the realized unit cell can reflect incident EM waves with 99.9% efficiency over a wide range of frequencies from 1 Hz to 40 GHz. Also, when the unit cell is loaded with lumped elements like a resistor and capacitor, it acts as an absorber. The magnitude of absorption is controlled by resistor, which can be varied from 79.17% to 99.97%, whereas the frequency at which absorption occurs can be tuned by varying capacitance. This unit cell configuration could achieve beam steering at sub 6 GHz, K and Ka-band frequencies. The dimensions of the proposed meta-atom is 8.4x8.4x1.56 mm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup> and formulated on Rogers RT duroid 5880.

articleTitle: E-Certificate Generation using MVC Model
abstract: With the advancement in digitalization over the internet, web development and its applications came into play. A web application is built as an interactive app using web development technologies. The purpose of developing this system is to replace the paper-based system with a digital system. This change in the system has allowed students to apply for their required certificates from anywhere in the world and track the status of their application. The end objective is to provide a dynamically generated certificate to the student.

articleTitle: Notebook Junction – An E-Stationery System
abstract: E-Stationary is a system that is built to facilitate the overall management of the stationery stock and its distribution. The main objective of developing this system is to help Stationery operators of "Notebook Junction" to manage their shop systematically and efficiently. This Website allows users to buy Stationery items in a very smooth manner according to their convenience. Through much research, the problem found is stationery still using the manual method to record stationery stock from the stored record file which leads to a gathering of the crowd around the shop which creates a nuisance and fuss. This system will help to modernize the stationary sector where customers can order their items/products from anywhere. In this system, a different algorithm is derived by the developers of this system by applying many algorithms and methodologies such as accepting orders on the basis of timestamp and sorting the orders based on the quantity into two different tables labeled as Low order and Bulk order. On the whole, the developed stationary management system can speed up the process.

articleTitle: Vehicle to Grid Technology: EV Power Generation Analysis through Plug in Charging Method
abstract: Electric vehicles have played wonderful roles in the global economy, resulting in significant growth and economic benefits in recent years. It offers more benefits than other vehicle systems and demonstrates more sustainable development, lower fuel consumption, and improved power system maintenance. Plug-in vehicles serve as both power source and a load, as well as a source of distributed energy, all of which contribute to the development of a new era of vehicle-to-grid technology (V2GTechnology). This paper provides information on how to control and analyze the frequency of a microgrid. Micro grids are an important component in power systems for consuming power values and providing an analysis of the comparison of base power generation and micro grid generations, as well as the combination of renewable energy elements. Different possible methods of generating power technology, lowering economic values, and providing various shades to the production of renewable energy sources in the micro grid. The results show information about the use of vehicle-to-grid technology and how to regulate frequencies, which is the development of power system nature and low spinning reserve methods.

articleTitle: Breast Tumor Segmentation using Cuckoo based Optimization
abstract: These days there are a few techniques for identifying the tumors in breasts. One of them is identifying tumors in light of the MRI tests of the specific individual. Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI) it helps in analyzing the tumors among breast tissues. In this image processing is utilized to build the quality of pictures.We are currently employing the K-means algorithm and CSO algorithm for our endeavors. K-means algorithm is utilized during the segmentation which plays out the operations on the MRI pictures. It characterizes the pixels into clusters. We are utilizing another optimization algorithm called cuckoo search optimization which helps in tracking down the optimal beginning centroids. We use RIDER breast MRI dataset to examine the effectiveness of our proposed techniques, we will clearly demonstrate the superiority of our algorithm compared to similar methodologies such as K-means algorithm and Fuzzy C-Means. The future results of the proposed method will be correlated with the results of another two other clustering algorithms: fuzzy c-means (FCM) and K-means clustering algorithms. The future outcomes will be in view of quality measure values for three methods and tried on pictures in RIDER breast dataset [1]. The upshot of this topic culminates in the proposal that the K-means algorithm may be refined and optimized by integrating a suitable algorithmic optimized technique like cuckoo search optimization (CSO).

articleTitle: Twitter Mining and Analysis of Traffic Conditions in India
abstract: In this paper, we address the growing concern of traffic violations in India caused by the increasing number of vehicles on the road and rising accidents and fatalities. To tackle this issue, we suggest the use of social media platforms, particularly Twitter, as a potential tool for identifying and analyzing traffic violations. Our approach involves leveraging the data available on the official Twitter handles of traffic police departments to develop a dataset of tweets related to traffic incidents and violations in four Indian metropolitan cities - Delhi, Mumbai, Kolkata and Chennai. The Delhi and Mumbai dataset is then used to train machine learning algorithms to identify Traffic Jams and Traffic Violations. As a future scope, using these results one can devise effective methods for quick identification and prevention of traffic violations in metropolitan cities. Our ultimate goal is to provide transportation authorities with new tools and insights for improving road traffic safety in India.

articleTitle: Recyclable and Non-Recyclable Waste Recognition using Image Processing with Machine Learning: Recycle Mate
abstract: Waste Management is the effort needed to make our world a better place. As solid waste may cause a problem for our surroundings. Nowadays many people don't even know how to distinguish between recyclable and non-recyclable objects, we know only some general things which are recyclable like paper, plastic, cardboard and drinking cans. To deal with this problem a deep machine-learning Convolution Neural Network (CNN) was created to help us all with an achievable waste management task. The automated task works for everyone as it lets down the burden of work from many people’s shoulders. Our model is built using the Keras API. The model categorizes the data into a binary class. It has been tested with many objects which gave an acceptable prediction accuracy.

articleTitle: Contention Based MAC Collision Avoidance Technique for Mobile Adhoc Networks
abstract: Mobile ad hoc networks (MANETs) have transformed providing services for a variety of real-time applications. In a MANET, a collection of wireless mobile nodes powered by batteries is configured into a dynamic topology and operate independently without external infrastructure. In OSI model, the Medium Access Control (MAC) sub-layer of the data link layer has the primary responsibility of managing the devices that connects with the transmission channel. Mobility and resource limitations are the two main aspects that have an impact on MANET's operation. Frequent link failures occur due to nodes mobility and sharing of single channel during data transmission results is packet collision during nodes movement. Packet collision leads to retransmissions, higher delay, packet loss and more energy consumption. In this paper we propose a collision avoidance technique using contention window (CAD-CW) for MANET’s to handle nodes unique characteristics such as mobility, link constrain and energy. CAD utilises dynamic contention window to adapt network changes and high priority data is allowed to transmit first to minimize collision. Energy efficient path is selected for reliable data transmission to handle QoS.

articleTitle: IsItPhish: Dynamic Phishing Website Detection
abstract: This Paper Discusses the development of a Chrome extension for detecting and preventing phishing attacks. The review gives an overview of the proposed methodology and their findings of the study, including the accuracy of the proposed approach. The paper also discusses the significance of research and its potential impact on improving online security. Overall, the review highlights the importance of the research and its contribution to the field of digital forensics and security. The paper also provides an overview of the current state of phishing attacks and their impact on the security of online users. The methodology and experimental results of the study are discussed in detail, including the dataset used and the performance metrics evaluated. The paper also identifies the drawbacks and difficulties of the suggested strategy and recommends new lines of inquiry for this area of study. Overall, this analysis offers insightful information about the usage of machine learning methods for identifying phishing websites and their potential utility in boosting online security.

articleTitle: Self-Learning Fuzzy Feedforward Compensation Algorithm In Photovoltaic MPPT
abstract: The application of self-learning fuzzy feedforward compensation algorithm in photovoltaic maximum power point tracking is to compensate the voltage and current of photovoltaic system. The basic idea of this method is to generate a set of compensation coefficients, so as to construct a light intensity feedforward compensation channel. At the same time, according to the disturbance observation results, the fuzzy rule base is online learned to eliminate the influence of temperature changes on the accuracy of nonlinear approximation. It is used to adjust the voltage and current values at different times according to the actual situation measured by the sensor (such as temperature, solar irradiance, etc.). This method can be used in DC and AC applications. In order to further improve the steady-state accuracy, the variable step disturbance observation method is used to design the feedback controller. Simulation and experimental results show that the proposed method has good adaptability and robustness to light intensity mutation, and significantly improves the conversion efficiency of photovoltaic system.

articleTitle: Frequency Domain Filter Implementation For Input Containing Outlier
abstract: This paper presents an overview of frequency domain LMS(Least Mean Square) algorithm for an input containing outlier.Signal processing have tendency to suppress the noise while leaving the signals unchanged by using system or filter.In signal processing the unwanted noise in the signal was removed or suppressed from the signal using adaptive filter. The filter coefficient of adaptive filter is capable of adjusting automatically to match the desired signal through an optimization algorithms . various algorithms have been implemented to recover the desired signal from the noise using different optimization technique such as Least mean square (LMS) and its variants and Recursive least square (RLS) etc.The convergence performance of LMS type adaptive filters is totally dependent on the correlation and on the eigenvalue of the input data.To enhance convergence peformance and reduce the complexity of a signal various transform domain adaptive filters have been developed . This proposed work presents an overview of the frequency domain LMS algorithm for system identification, for input containing outlier. Frequency domain LMS adaptive filter is investigated for input data using Discrete Fourier transformation (DFT) technique. Compared to the traditional adaptive filter the convergence speed and performance analysis of the proposed method shows better performance in terms of Mean Square Error (MSE), Excess Mean Square Error (EMSE) and Mean Square Deviation (MSD) with input containing 10 percent outlier.

articleTitle: Brain Tumor Detection Using ResNet Architectures
abstract: Any tumor occurs in the body due to uncontrolled and rapid growth of cells at a particular body part and then also affecting the healthy cells in the vicinity.
